answer: Give each identity an anchor it cannot share: its own Bitcoin coin. To earn, an agent must prove control of a distinct outpoint holding 100,000 sats (illustrative, about $90) locked by CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY to a horizon 26 weeks out. The ledger accepts each outpoint once, so clones can't share a coin, and batching can't help. Rewards flow through an inlet that stays open only while that lock runs; when it expires the agent re-locks or goes quiet. A farm of 1,000 fakes ties up about $90,000 for half a year, linear in clones.
